reviews.text: This clinic literally saved our cat this year when other vets we consulted said she was going to die. The vets here truly love animals.

Personally, I've never seen a veterinary clinic so efficient, compassionate, and accommodating, and I'm at a loss for words to describe it. This team deserves top honors, and I'm not exaggerating. They saved Bibi, my mother's cat, and we can't thank them enough. Go there without hesitation! They were so caring and understanding. Thank you for taking care of our Bibi while my mother recovered. Without you, he might not be here today. We love you so much. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts. May the best come to you. You truly deserve it!
They listened very well! They are fantastic and provided excellent support.

Thank you, Dr. Mallet, for taking Frérot in as an emergency, for helping him every day to avoid suffering during his final moments. You are an exceptional person. Thank you also to the entire team for the comfort you provided us. 🐈 …

I took my cat in for an emergency appointment because of a visible injury to its mouth. I was turned away at the entrance, and at reception they told me they wouldn't see my cat even though there was no one else at the clinic…
I understand it's an animal clinic, but the hygiene is lacking; it's not like that at my usual vet's.

This wasn't the vet I usually take my cat to, but since it's in my neighborhood and my cat's mouth was covered in blood, I went there as an emergency.
At reception, the manager told me they couldn't see my cat. She went to ask the vet inside, and then they refused to see me. Even without a full examination, they could have simply opened my cat's mouth to quickly check if there was anything serious. That would have reassured me. Yet, neither the vet nor the receptionist took a single second to help us.

This place is awful and completely devoid of humanity. In fact, I was already shocked once, when I went in to buy Virbac cat food, by the enormous markup they put on the products they sell. But the horrible experience I had today surpasses all of that.

Furthermore, the consultation room didn't seem hygienic at all, which worried me even more. In the end, I'm glad I took my cat to my own vet.

Don't even bother going near this place.

One more thing: despite the numerous negative reviews about the receptionist, I still don't understand why she still works there. You should seriously have a talk with her, otherwise you seem doomed to be constantly left empty-handed.
